    § 02 · The Method

    Designed to train, test, and transform.

    COMPASS is built on the conviction that human resources fluency is a strategic capability — not a soft skill. Every module pairs business-English precision with people judgment, workplace literacy, and the professional clarity that defines premium HR leaders.

    01

    Premium Curriculum

    One hundred modules covering every domain of modern human resources — from the foundations of recruitment and onboarding to AI-powered talent management and hybrid work.

    02

    Realistic Scenarios

    Every MCQ is rooted in plausible professional situations — performance conversations, employee relations, compliance audits, talent reviews — written for international HR professionals.

    03

    Automatic Grading

    Instant scoring with tiered performance feedback — from foundational to executive fluency — plus the vocabulary and strategic insight earned from each module.

    04

    Progress That Tracks

    Your completion and scores are tracked live as you move through the program. Revisit your strongest topics anytime in this session, or retake a module to refine your fluency.

    B.G.
    § 03 · The Author

    Brice Gadou

    Business English Expert

    Brice Gadou is a Business English specialist dedicated to building world-class language training for international professionals. COMPASS reflects his vision: human resources fluency as strategic capability — a multiplier of trust, clarity, and genuine care for people.

    Designed for the HR generalists, talent leads, and people leaders shaping how organizations treat their most valuable asset — COMPASS is more than vocabulary. It's the fluency to communicate in the discipline most responsible for making work genuinely work for people.
